evidence_kind: static client analysis; synthetic verification tracked separately

load.observed_static_behavior: HTTP 200 through 206 parses the protobuf response and applies the deduplicated fog ids. Load is called after front character selection.

save.observed_static_behavior: Discovery inserts a newly seen area locally and sends one id. Save completion reads HTTP status without parsing a response body. Therefore server saves must merge discoveries.

limits: The client owns the fog discovery decision; authoritative server polygon traversal is not implemented.
Adventure Progress objective counters and collection achievements are separate from fog persistence.
No original-client trial against the updated emulator or live-service deployment is established by this evidence.
World-only official capture logs do not include these REST requests.
